items.title: [BUG] Critical Issue - Error 463 (Reachout Timelock) Causing Account Bans
items.body:
We are experiencing a critical issue where WhatsApp accounts using Baileys are getting temporarily banned (Error 463 - Reachout Timelock) when trying to send messages to users who haven't been contacted before.

Problem Details

1. Error 463 occurs when attempting to send messages to new contacts or users who haven't interacted with the bot recently.
2. Current Behavior: Baileys does not automatically handle the Trusted Contact (TC) Token / Privacy Token required by WhatsApp to establish trust with new contacts.
3. Result: Repeated Error 463 responses lead to temporary account restrictions and bans, making bots unreliable for legitimate use cases.

Technical Context

WhatsApp requires a Trusted Contact (TC) Token (also known as privacy token) for 1-on-1 messaging between users who haven't established recent conversation history. This token:

· Is issued by WhatsApp servers via a privacy IQ request
· Has a lifespan of approximately 28 days

items.title: Getting banned first day.
items.body:
So I've been trying to use this framework, I managed to succesfully set it up, register my phone and login. I made use of the example code in the repository. (Only hihelp.py to be honest). I also made a second attempt using my own script, which basically just sends random answers I defined in an array, but both of the times I got banned within 24 hours.

I followed the guidelines on this wiki. I didnt spam, I only sent around 20 messages over a time span of a couple of hours. I set myself in the contact list, and I made sure I was the only one messaging the bot. The bot never started a conversation itself, since it only responds to my messages. I'm not even in any groups.

Since it was the first time using the framework, I haven't registered any other devices yet. The second time I guess I did...? But I'm doubting that's the issue since I still got banned the first time.

Lastly, I obviously made no use of the yowsup-cli.
